children: Senti Biosciences amended its Securities Purchase Agreement on September 1, 2026 to allow Senior Secured Convertible Notes to be issued in more than two tranches and specifically authorize a $2.0 million third-tranche issuance to NSG BioInnovation Fund. With CPIF II-7's consent, the NSG purchase will satisfy the remaining obligation of Celadon Partners SPV 35 under the merger agreement. Closing is expected within three business days, subject to customary conditions. The amendment increases financing flexibility as the company advances its strategic transactions.
: Amendment to Securities Purchase Agreement for Senior Secured Convertible Notes
: Expand note financing flexibility and complete remaining purchase obligation
